claims.object_text: genetic epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS+)
claims.quote: is a well-known causative gene for genetic epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS+)
A novel heterozygous missense variant in GABRG2 (c.964G>A; p.Ala322Thr) was identified in patient 1, patient 2, and their father.
Patient 1 developed drug-resistant epilepsy requiring multiple anti-seizure medications (ASMs).
Patient 2 exhibited milder epilepsy, controlled with a single ASM.
Patient 3 has remained seizure-free under low-dose ASM.

claims.object_text: febrile and afebrile seizures in childhood
claims.quote: The father had febrile and afebrile seizures in childhood but has been seizure-free for over 10 years with ASMs.
This intrafamilial phenotypic variability was observed despite all affected individuals carrying the same variant.

claims.object_text: M2 segment of GABRG2 is functionally important
claims.quote: the identified variant is located in the M2 segment of GABRG2, which is functionally important
